definitions.explanation: The cost of electricity usage, typically paid monthly.

examples.japanese: {電気代|でんきだい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
{電気代|でんきだい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧。
⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦エアコン→エアコン：05282_eakon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、{電気代|でんきだい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: The electricity bill goes up in summer because we use the air conditioner.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{電気|でんき}→電気：09780_denki⟧ (electricity) + ⟦{代|だい}→〜代：28331_dai⟧ (cost/charge). Refers to the monthly electricity bill.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {電気代|でんきだい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧: to pay the electricity bill
- {電気代|でんきだい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{節約|せつやく}する→節約する：25226_setsuyakusuru⟧: to save on electricity costs
- {電気代|でんきだい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧/⟦{下|さ}がる→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧: the bill goes up/down
- {電気代|でんきだい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧: electricity costs add up

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{電気料金|でんきりょうきん}→電気料金：26946_denkiryoukin⟧ is the more formal/official term for electricity charges, used on bills and by utility companies. {電気代|でんきだい} is the everyday conversational form.

RELATED UTILITY COSTS:
- ⟦{水道代|すいどうだい}→水道代：09544_suidoudai⟧: water bill
- ⟦ガス{代|だい}→ガス代：08943_gasudai⟧: gas bill
- ⟦{光熱費|こうねつひ}→光熱費：08244_kounetsuhi⟧: utility costs (electricity + gas + heating combined)
- {通信費|つうしんひ}: communication costs (phone, internet)

The 〜⟦{代|だい}→〜代：28331_dai⟧ suffix is commonly used for costs: ⟦{電話代|でんわだい}→電話代：11336_denwadai⟧ (phone bill), {食事代|しょくじだい} (meal cost), ⟦{家賃|やちん}→家賃：03639_yachin⟧ (rent, though this uses a different suffix).
